cat << 'EOF' > /work/solve_chair_exact.py
import json, math, numpy as np
from PIL import Image

with open('/work/history.jsonl') as f:
    history = [json.loads(line) for line in f]

x, y, yaw = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
poses = {}
for h in history:
    act = h['requested_action']
    yaw = (yaw + act['turn_deg']) % 360
    rad = math.radians(yaw)
    x += act['move_m'] * math.sin(rad)
    y += act['move_m'] * math.cos(rad)
    poses[h['frame']] = (round(x, 4), round(y, 4), round(yaw, 2))

print("Pose 26:", poses[26])

def ground_pt(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, cam_yaw):
    H = 1.55
    d_fwd = H * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)
    d_right = H * (u - 256.0) / (v - 256.0)
    rad = math.radians(cam_yaw)
    wx = cam_x + d_fwd * math.sin(rad) + d_right * math.cos(rad)
    wy = cam_y + d_fwd * math.cos(rad) - d_right * math.sin(rad)
    return wx, wy, d_fwd, d_right

im26 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0026.png'))
m_ch26 = (im26[:,:,0] > 90) & (im26[:,:,0] < 160) & (im26[:,:,1] > 40) & (im26[:,:,1] < 90) & (im26[:,:,2] < 45)
c_ch26 = np.argwhere(m_ch26)

# Find bottom of each leg:
# Leg 1 (front center):
v_max = c_ch26[:,0].max()
leg_front = c_ch26[c_ch26[:,0] == v_max]
u_front = (leg_front[:,1].min() + leg_front[:,1].max()) / 2.0
pt_front = ground_pt(u_front, v_max, poses[26][0], poses[26][1], poses[26][2])
print("Front leg:", pt_front[:2], "v=", v_max)

# Leg 2 (left):
leg_left = c_ch26[(c_ch26[:,1] < 250) & (c_ch26[:,0] > 380)]
v_left = leg_left[:,0].max()
u_left = (leg_left[leg_left[:,0] == v_left][:,1].min() + leg_left[leg_left[:,0] == v_left][:,1].max()) / 2.0
pt_left = ground_pt(u_left, v_left, poses[26][0], poses[26][1], poses[26][2])
print("Left leg:", pt_left[:2], "v=", v_left)

# Leg 3 (right):
leg_right = c_ch26[(c_ch26[:,1] > 300) & (c_ch26[:,0] > 380)]
v_right = leg_right[:,0].max()
u_right = (leg_right[leg_right[:,0] == v_right][:,1].min() + leg_right[leg_right[:,0] == v_right][:,1].max()) / 2.0
pt_right = ground_pt(u_right, v_right, poses[26][0], poses[26][1], poses[26][2])
print("Right leg:", pt_right[:2], "v=", v_right)

# Leg 4 (back):
leg_back = c_ch26[(c_ch26[:,1] > 260) & (c_ch26[:,1] < 290) & (c_ch26[:,0] > 360) & (c_ch26[:,0] < 400)]
v_back = leg_back[:,0].max()
u_back = (leg_back[leg_back[:,0] == v_back][:,1].min() + leg_back[leg_back[:,0] == v_back][:,1].max()) / 2.0
pt_back = ground_pt(u_back, v_back, poses[26][0], poses[26][1], poses[26][2])
print("Back leg:", pt_back[:2], "v=", v_back)

chair_cen_x = (pt_front[0] + pt_left[0] + pt_right[0] + pt_back[0]) / 4.0
chair_cen_y = (pt_front[1] + pt_left[1] + pt_right[1] + pt_back[1]) / 4.0
print(f"Exact chair ground center: ({chair_cen_x:.3f}, {chair_cen_y:.3f})")
